source.title: Philocoffea: the 4:6 method (light ~93 °C, medium ~88 °C, dark ~83 °C)
source.notes: medium-light and medium-dark are midpoints between the published levels. Japanese Coffee Gear's translation gives 92–94 / 88–91 / 85–88 °C.

source.title: Cafec roast-level papers: T-92 light 92 °C, T-90 medium 90 °C, T-83 dark 83 °C
Transcription of Lance Hedrick's 'Ultimate Pourover Recipe' (light 100, medium 92, dark 85 °C)
source.notes: Also gives ratio by roast: light 1:15–1:17, medium 1:15, dark 1:14. medium-light and medium-dark are midpoints.

description.en: Clean and bright. Shows the origin clearly. The reference process; recipes assume it.
description.pt-BR: Limpo e brilhante. Mostra a origem com clareza. É o processo de referência; as receitas assumem ele.

description.en: Dried in the whole cherry. Full body, heavy sweetness, wild fruit. Roasters suggest a slightly coarser grind, a little less heat and a touch more water.
description.pt-BR: Secado na cereja inteira. Corpo cheio, doçura intensa, frutas selvagens. Torrefadores sugerem moagem um pouco mais grossa, um pouco menos calor e um pouco mais água.

source.title: The Roasters Pack: how to brew natural coffees (coarser, 96 → 92 °C, 1:16.5, gentler pours)
source.notes: Roaster guidance. Hoffmann, Rao and Barista Hustle publish no process-specific brewing changes; Rao (2024) changes only grind between coffees.

description.en: Part of the mucilage stays on the seed while drying. Sweet, medium-full body. Brew as washed; go a degree cooler if it tastes heavy.
description.pt-BR: Parte da mucilagem fica no grão durante a secagem. Doce, corpo médio a cheio. Prepare como lavado; baixe um grau se ficar pesado.

source.title: Roaster guidance; treated as between washed and natural

description.en: Fermented in a sealed tank without oxygen. Winey, intense, tropical. Roasters suggest 88–91 °C, a coarser grind and 1:16.5–1:17.
description.pt-BR: Fermentado em tanque selado sem oxigênio. Vinhoso, intenso, tropical. Torrefadores sugerem 88–91 °C, moagem mais grossa e 1:16,5–1:17.

source.title: The Blind Coffee Roaster: how to brew anaerobic process coffee (88–91 °C, 750–800 µm vs ~600, 1:16.5–1:17)

description.en: Whole cherries fermented under CO₂, borrowed from wine. Very aromatic. Treat like an anaerobic coffee.
description.pt-BR: Cerejas inteiras fermentadas em CO₂, técnica emprestada do vinho. Muito aromático. Trate como um café anaeróbico.

description.en: Fermented with added fruit or yeast. Extreme, divisive flavour. Treat like an anaerobic coffee and taste often.
description.pt-BR: Fermentado com frutas ou leveduras adicionadas. Sabor extremo e divisivo. Trate como anaeróbico e prove com frequência.

source.title: The Roasters Pack: experimental ferments treated like naturals
